import java.util.*;

    static int[][] memoTable = new int[262155][31];
    static boolean[][] visitedTable = new boolean[262155][31];
    static int[] bitLog = new int[262155];
    static int[] twoSum = new int[262155];
    static List<int[]> processingOrder = new ArrayList<>();

    static void inputInt(int[] val) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String line = br.readLine();
        String[] parts = line.split("\\s+");
        val[0] = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
    }

    static void inputLL(long[] val) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String line = br.readLine();
        String[] parts = line.split("\\s+");
        val[0] = Long.parseLong(parts[0]);
    }

    static int modPow(int base, long exp) {
        int res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                res = (int) (((long) res * base) % MOD);
            }
            base = (int) (((long) base * base) % MOD);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int countTwos(int x) {
        int cnt = 0;
        while (x != 0 && (x & 1) == 0) {
            ++cnt;
            x >>= 1;
        }
        return cnt;
    }

    static int nCr(int N, int M) {
        return (int) (((long) fact[N] * invFact[M]) % MOD * invFact[N - M] % MOD);
    }

    static int topDown(int N, int K) {
        if (N == 0) return 1;
        if (K == 0) return 0;
        if (memoTable[N][K] != -1) return memoTable[N][K];
        
        int step = 1 << bitLog[N];
        int sum = 0;
        for (int i = N; i >= step; i -= 2) {
            sum = (sum + (int) (((long) nCr(N, i) * topDown(N - i, K - 1) % MOD) * K) % MOD) % MOD;
        }
        return memoTable[N][K] = sum;
    }

    static int bottomUp(int N, int K) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{N, K});
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int curN = cur[0];
            int curK = cur[1];
            processingOrder.add(new int[]{curN, curK});
            
            if (curN == 0 || curK == 0) continue;
            
            int step = 1 << bitLog[curN];
            for (int i = curN; i >= step; i -= 2) {
                if (twoSum[i] + twoSum[curN - i] == twoSum[curN] && !visitedTable[curN - i][curK - 1]) {
                    visitedTable[curN - i][curK - 1] = true;
                    q.add(new int[]{curN - i, curK - 1});
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = processingOrder.size() - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
            int[] cur = processingOrder.get(i);
            int curN = cur[0];
            int curK = cur[1];
            
            if (curN == 0) {
                memoTable[curN][curK] = 1;
                continue;
            }
            if (curK == 0) {
                memoTable[curN][curK] = 0;
                continue;
            }
            
            int step = 1 << bitLog[curN];
            for (int i_val = curN; i_val >= step; i_val -= 2) {
                if (twoSum[i_val] + twoSum[curN - i_val] == twoSum[curN]) {
                    memoTable[curN][curK] = (memoTable[curN][curK] + (int) (((long) nCr(curN, i_val) * memoTable[curN - i_val][curK - 1] % MOD) * curK) % MOD) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        
        return memoTable[N][K];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        int[] nArr = new int[1];
        int[] kArr = new int[1];
        long[] modArr = new long[1];

            fact[i] = (int) (((long) fact[i - 1] * i) % MOD);
            bitLog[i] = bitLog[i >> 1] + 1;
            twoSum[i] = twoSum[i - 1] + countTwos(i);

        invFact[262150] = modPow(fact[262150], MOD - 2);
        for (int i = 262149; i >= 1; --i) {
            invFact[i] = (int) (((long) invFact[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % MOD);
